verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an SDK-based tracing integration for LiveKit agents (a page under integrations/livekit/tracing). It also stores each call as a CallLog, which loosely resembles a session unit. Nothing in the pack shows nested spans for multi-step runs or grouping of traces into sessions or threads, and the tracing is evidenced only for LiveKit. Missing for 10: documented nested span hierarchy, session/thread grouping of traces, framework-agnostic tracing instrumentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Enhanced observability for LiveKit agents using the Cekura SDK
Enable deep observability for LiveKit agents with SDK integration
Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
